relationships.subject: ACE inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: The ACE inhibitors enalapril and captopril enhanced reserpine-induced mechanical allodynia, and this increase was prevented by kinin B1 and B2 receptor antagonists.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Substance P and bradykinin caused overt nociception and increased mechanical allodynia in animals treated with reserpine.

relationships.subject: ACE inhibitors
relationships.evidence_quote: Reserpine plus ACE inhibitors increased bradykinin-related peptide levels and inhibited ACE activity in pain modulation structures.

key_findings: ACE inhibitors enalapril and captopril worsen reserpine-induced fibromyalgia-like allodynia via kinin B1 and B2 receptors and raise bradykinin-related peptides.
